note: Proposed rounds for a later question batch, not part of questions/season0.json. No unscored pilot: owner rule G3 waives it because fill-in was measured directly. The first scored lock is Sun 2026-12-13 23:59 ET, the same night as the Seattle calls family, and is scored only if the fill-in confirmation passes: on Fri 2026-12-11 a maintainer runs `python -m ssa.adapters.nyc311 fillin 2026-11-23` (+8 against +11 snapshots, growth under 0.5%); if it fails, nyc311-2026-12-20 runs unscored, announced before its lock. Needs the adapter and these rounds on main with the scheduled refresh running by Sun 2026-11-29 (14 days for participants). If the lock capture shows a reference week failing the outage check, the block steps back one week and the question text must say so before posting. Each round is posted only if `python -m ssa.adapters.nyc311 reference <monday>` succeeds on the fresh capture of the 24 h before its lock. Manual mode, if maintainers choose it, resolves on the Sunday download six days after the week ends and its question and resolve text change accordingly; a round never switches mode.

rounds.question: How many NYC 311 service requests will have a created_date in the week Monday 2026-12-14 to Sunday 2026-12-20, New York local time? Count every row of NYC Open Data dataset erm2-nwe9 (311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present): all complaint types, agencies, statuses and channels, citywide. There is no publisher release calendar: SSA sets and resolves this metric from its own archive of the dataset (docs/sources.md section 1.1), under card nyc-311-requests@v2. Ranked reference: mean4, the mean of the four settled weeks starting 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-30, with sd the root-mean-square of its own errors over 13 settled weeks; its mean, sd and four weekly counts are published and hashed at lock. Mode: automated daily capture.
rounds.resolve: sum over the seven target days of the first fresh snapshot archived under sources/nyc311/ (X-SODA2-Data-Out-Of-Date false) at or after Tuesday 12:00 America/New_York eight days after the week ends, whose X-SODA2-Truth-Last-Modified is after Monday 18:00 ET; a target day under 40% of the 28-day median or with no rows for NYPD, HPD, DSNY, DOT or DEP moves to the next fresh snapshot until Friday 12:00 ET, after which the round is cancelled (ssa/adapters/nyc311.py resolve, mode auto)
